headline: TSLA slips ~2% premarket as Musk joins Trump's China delegation (May 13–15) — Elon Musk confirmed in Beijing party alongside Apple CEO Tim Cook, BlackRock CEO Larry Fink, Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon, and others; Tesla's China FSD approval has slipped from Q2 to Q3 2026 target after Musk suggested Feb/Mar timing last year; diplomatic access to Chinese leadership viewed as potential near-term unlock for Tesla's largest untapped FSD market; TSLA closed at $445 on May 11 (+3.89%) and is ripping above its 200-day moving average (BBC / Stocktwits / NDTV Profit)

Tesla FSD gains new European foothold — Ireland's Department of Transport confirms active engagement with Tesla and the National Standards Authority of Ireland (NSAI) ahead of potential FSD Supervised approval; follows Netherlands (April 10) and Sweden (April 27) greenlights; Tesla targeting broader EU deployment 'as early as summer 2026'; harmonized EU-wide clearance requires 15/27 member states — next Technical Committee vote: July 2026 (Teslarati / RTE)

Tesla Spring 2026 software update 2026.14 rolling out — flagship feature: dedicated 'Hey Grok' wake word for xAI voice assistant integrated directly into vehicle UI; new standalone Self-Driving subscription app; Pet Mode with custom avatars; larger navigation dock icons; Blind Spot Warning Accent Lights; Immersive Sound Upgrade; rear display improvements; AI-powered cabin camera now assessing driver age for safety compliance; one of Tesla's biggest OTA updates of the year (notateslaapp / tesla-info.com)

TSLA closes at $445 on May 11 (+3.89%) — stock ripping above 200-day moving average; +33% off the post-earnings $373 low set Apr 23; +12.6% YTD; approaching $450–$460 resistance zone; Piper Sandler (Alex Potter) reiterates that Tesla's core EV and energy businesses justify ~$400/share alone, making Optimus, robotaxi, and AI inference 'essentially free' optionality at current prices; bull case reinforced by accelerating Austin robotaxi unsupervised rate and Cybercab production ramp (Yahoo Finance / IBTimes)

Austin robotaxi fleet: 50 active rider vehicles + 38 Cybercabs in test fleet; unsupervised ride rate hits 66.7% — 28 of 42 rides in last 7 days with no safety driver; up from 59.0% on May 8 and 27.8% on May 6; fleet now operating unsupervised during evening hours for first time as of May 4; pace of autonomous operational maturity accelerating sharply across both daytime and night sessions (robotaxitracker.com / Teslarati)

Tesla China retail sales fell 10% YoY in April to 25,956 units — domestic sales fell 15% YoY; the widely reported '+36% April surge' was wholesale/export output from Giga Shanghai including European and APAC exports, NOT Chinese consumer purchases; Q1 2026 China retail crashed 16% YoY with January alone down 45%; Tesla now risks falling behind Xiaomi in China market share by end of 2026 as domestic BEV market grew +2.4% YoY in April; bear signal for the China delivery recovery thesis (Electrek / CnEVPost)

Tesla builds last-ever Model S and Model X at Fremont — factory line now converting to Optimus production; Fremont line targeting 1M robots/year at full capacity; Signature Edition final delivery event for existing reservation holders postponed; end of Tesla's flagship luxury EV era marks the beginning of its robotics-first manufacturing era (evxl.co / Electrek / TeslaNorth)

SpaceX formally files plan for Terafab chip factory costing $55B–$119B — joint Tesla/SpaceX semiconductor facility in Texas enters formal planning phase; research fab at Giga Texas (~$3B) will produce AI5-class chips in small batches; full Terafab scope $55B minimum with total exceeding $119B; Intel 14A process confirmed; SpaceX filing notes 'no assurance' on timeline; one of the largest private infrastructure investments in history if fully built (CNBC / Bloomberg / Reuters)
